news_items.headline: Expeditors International (EXPD) Q1 Earnings and Revenues Surpass Estimates
news_items.summary: Q1 2026 EPS $1.71 (+16.3% YoY) beat Zacks consensus $1.33. Revenue $2.78B (+4.4% YoY) beat $2.58B consensus. Operating income $294.8M (+11% YoY); operating margin expanded to ~10.6% from ~10%.

news_items.headline: EXPD Q1 Earnings & Revenues Top Estimates on Airfreight Strength
news_items.summary: Airfreight services revenue rose to $1.03B on higher volumes and firmer yields earlier in quarter; airfreight tonnage +5% YoY driven by technology customers. Customs brokerage and other services revenue $1.15B, helped by tariff-driven complexity and pricing initiatives.

news_items.headline: Expeditors Q1 EPS rises 16% to $1.71, revenue up 4%
news_items.summary: Stocktitan release: Q1 2026 EPS $1.71 vs prior-year $1.47, revenue $2.78B vs prior-year $2.66B. Highlights non-asset-based model resilience amid geopolitical disruptions.

news_items.headline: Earnings Flash: EXPD Reports Q1 Revenue $2.78B vs FactSet Est $2.61B
news_items.summary: Revenue $2.78B beat FactSet consensus $2.61B by ~6.5%. Confirms top-line outperformance versus street expectations.

news_items.headline: Susquehanna raises EXPD price target to $156 from $142
news_items.summary: Susquehanna raised PT to $156 from $142 following Q1 beat. Price target now sits near top end of analyst range ($95-$166).

news_items.headline: Goldman Sachs lowers EXPD price target to $107 from $110
news_items.summary: Goldman Sachs trimmed PT to $107 from $110, sitting below current price levels and contributing to the mixed Hold consensus despite the Q1 beat.

news_items.headline: Ocean freight & ocean services revenue declines on industry pressure
news_items.summary: Ocean freight and ocean services revenue declined to $598.9M as industry conditions remained pressured. Offset by airfreight strength but a notable soft segment.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Susquehanna raised PT to $156 from $142 (2026-05-06) post Q1 beat; Goldman Sachs lowered PT to $107 from $110 (2026-05-06). Consensus: 1 Buy / 9 Hold / 7 Sell across 11-analyst panel; broader 19-analyst median PT $128 (range $95-$166).
